# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old when introduced, later older and married  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden / Housekeeper  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P75](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0075), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a freckled face, a snub nose, and a very wide smile. In her youth, she wore her hair in crinkly braids tied with prominent blue ribbon bows. As a young woman, she stopped wearing the bows and styled her hair in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is fiercely loyal, cheerful, and hard-working, serving her mistress with deep devotion. She possesses a literal mind and little patience for men, though she can be superstitious and prone to worrying that things will go wrong. She admires Anne Shirley wholeheartedly, often attempting to imitate her gestures and speech.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)_

## History

Leonora Bowman entered the service of Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge as a young handmaiden, following in the footsteps of her three older sisters. Because of her sisters' legacy, Miss Lavendar dubbed her 'Charlotta the Fourth.' She welcomed Anne Shirley and Diana Barry to Echo Lodge and enthusiastically assisted in preparing for Stephen Irving's return and his eventual wedding to Miss Lavendar. Following the marriage, she moved with Mr. and Mrs. Irving to Boston. She later married an American bricklayer named Tom, returning to Prince Edward Island to attend Anne's wedding to Gilbert Blythe.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 c28 P54](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0054), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual given name is Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the fourth and youngest of the Bowman girls to live with and work for Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- Her mistress called all her young hired girls 'Charlotta' to avoid confusion  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Some women’s intended from the start to be old maids, and I’m afraid I’m one of them, Miss Shirley, ma’am, because I’ve awful little patience with the men.  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

> In this world you’ve just got to hope for the best and prepare for the worst and take whatever God sends.  <sub>[v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016)</sub>

> I never did think I’d come down to marrying a Yankee, Miss Shirley, ma’am. But you never know what’s before you, and it isn’t his fault. He was born that way.  <sub>[v4 c3 P38](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0038)</sub>
